basic.description:
{Basic Estates}

The hero generates {250} gold per day for the owning player. In addition, the hero improves Marketplace exchange rates for the entire team as if it had {1} additional Marketplace.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Estates}

The hero generates {500} gold per day for the owning player. In addition, the hero improves Marketplace exchange rates for the entire team as if it had {2} additional Marketplaces.

expert.description:
{Expert Estates}

The hero generates {1000} gold per day for the owning player. In addition, the hero improves Marketplace exchange rates for the entire team as if it had {3} additional Marketplaces.
